klaim.bukti: Forty two trees were photographed from two sides with cameras mounted at three heights. [...] Although the yield estimate error for a single tree was sometimes large, the overall yield estimate was within 10% of the actual yield.
klaim.catatan: Semua angka cocok (42 pohon, dua sisi, tiga ketinggian, enam citra, 14 pohon kalibrasi). Catatan: pada 10 ulangan subset kalibrasi, galat pohon validasi melebihi 10% satu kali per pendekatan (A10 -10,49%; B10 12,51%); galat seluruh pohon selalu di bawah 10%.

klaim.bukti: Fourteen trees were selected randomly in order to derive a relationship between the 'tree counts' and the actual tree yield. This relationship was then applied to all the 'tree count' results to produce an estimate of the yield of each tree.
klaim.catatan: Asumsi rasio stabil adalah tafsiran penulis tinjauan, tetapi sesuai dengan metode: satu hubungan linear dari 14 pohon diterapkan ke pohon lain; jumlah terdeteksi hanya sekitar sepertiga hasil aktual (h. 5).

klaim.bukti: we propose AgriSORT, a simple, online, real-time tracking-by-detection pipeline for precision agriculture based only on motion information [...] table grape vineyard, particularly challenging due to strong self-similarity and density of the instances.
klaim.catatan: Argumen target statis berpenampilan serupa ada di abstrak dan h. 2 ("all crops are visually similar and static"). Tolok ukur anggur meja: empat sekuens beranotasi (Tabel I, h. 3); kode dan data dinyatakan tersedia.

klaim.bukti: the DeepSORT algorithm was successfully applied for counting sweet peppers, demonstrating an accuracy level of 85.7% in two simulated environments
klaim.perbaikan: Viveros Escamilla et al. tracked sweet peppers of four colours, classified into four maturity stages, with YOLOv5 and DeepSORT; the abstract reports 85.7% counting accuracy in two simulated environments (videos assembled from 70 still greenhouse images each), whereas the results table reports MOTA of 0.88 and 0.87.
klaim.catatan: Angka 85,7% hanya muncul di abstrak; badan naskah (Tabel 6) melaporkan MOTA 0,88 dan 0,87 dan tidak pernah menyebut 85,7% maupun galat hitungan. Lingkungan simulasi berupa video dari susunan 70 foto diam, bukan lintasan kamera nyata; kualifikasi ini mengubah makna.

klaim.bukti: an optimized YOLOv3 tiny network namely YOLO-P is proposed to detect and localize three objects at palm oil plantation which include fresh fruit bunch, grabber and palm tree under various environment conditions.
klaim.catatan: Bagian yang dinilai hanya "bunches, grabbers, and palms in plantation scenes"; bagian citra UAV milik junos2022automatic. Teks lengkap tidak terjangkau, penilaian dari abstrak.
